title: Shadow of the Shark
author: Mary Pope Osborne
desc: Jack and Annie's dream vacation to Cozumel turns into a real Mayan adventure — complete with a shark, a secret underworld, and a brave girl named Heart-of-the-Wind! 🦈

q.en: Who is Heart-of-the-Wind, the Mayan girl who helps Jack and Annie escape?
q.zh: 帮助杰克和安妮逃走的玛雅女孩“风中之心”是谁？

options.en: The daughter of the Great Sun of Palenque
options.zh: 帕伦克“太阳大帝”的女儿

options.en: The captain of a fishing boat from Cozumel
options.zh: 科苏梅尔一艘渔船上船长

options.en: A tourist staying at the luxury spa hotel
options.zh: 住在豪华温泉酒店里的游客

options.en: A Mayan warrior who captures Jack and Annie
options.zh: 抓走杰克和安妮的玛雅武士

explain.en: Heart-of-the-Wind is the only child of the Great Sun, ruler of the kingdom of Palenque. She helps Jack and Annie slip out of the City of Dawn and leads them through the forest and the Underworld to the sea.
explain.zh: “风中之心”是帕伦克王国统治者“太阳大帝”的独生女儿。她帮杰克和安妮溜出“黎明之城”，带着他们穿过森林和地下世界来到海边。

q.en: What kind of shark ends up carrying Jack and Annie's raft all the way back to Cozumel?
q.zh: 最后把杰克和安妮的木筏一路驮回科苏梅尔的是哪种鲨鱼？

options.en: A great white shark
options.zh: 大白鲨

options.en: A hammerhead shark
options.zh: 双髻鲨

options.en: A whale shark
options.zh: 鲸鲨

options.en: A tiger shark
options.zh: 虎鲨

explain.en: The travel guide says the whale shark is the biggest fish in the world, eats only plants and small fish, never harms people, and sometimes lets divers hitch a ride. The gentle giant balances their raft on its back to Cozumel.
explain.zh: 旅游指南说鲸鲨是世界上最大的鱼，只吃水草和小鱼，从不伤害人，有时还会让潜水员搭便车。这只温柔的巨鲨把他们的木筏稳稳驮在背上送回科苏梅尔。

q.en: What does Teddy give Jack and Annie to help them have fun on their vacation?
q.zh: 泰迪给了杰克和安妮什么，让他们在度假时玩得开心？

options.en: A heavy leather backpack filled with silver and gold coins
options.zh: 一个沉甸甸的皮背包，装满了银币和金币

options.en: A long letter signed by Merlin and Morgan le Fay
options.zh: 一封梅林和摩根·勒·菲共同署名的长信

options.en: A green velvet purse with three magic gold coins
options.zh: 一个绿色天鹅绒钱袋，里面有三枚魔法金币

options.en: A worn-out map and a brass compass from Camelot
options.zh: 一张破旧的地图和一只来自卡米洛特的黄铜指南针

explain.en: Teddy hands Jack a green velvet coin purse holding three golden coins. Each coin holds a bit of magic: tossed into the air with a wish to have fun, the wish comes true.
explain.zh: 泰迪递给杰克一个绿色天鹅绒钱袋，里面装着三枚金币。每枚金币都带一点魔法：抛向空中并许下“玩得开心”的愿望，愿望就会实现。

q.en: When a shark attacks their raft, what does Annie wish for with the FIRST gold coin?
q.zh: 当鲨鱼袭击他们的木筏时，安妮用第一枚金币许了什么愿？

options.en: To have fun escaping the shark
options.zh: 开心地摆脱那条鲨鱼

options.en: To turn themselves into expert swimmers
options.zh: 让自己变成游泳高手

options.en: To fly all the way back to Frog Creek
options.zh: 一路飞回青蛙溪

options.en: To find their lost travel guide on the beach
options.zh: 在沙滩上找到他们丢失的旅游指南

explain.en: Annie grabs the purse, holds up a coin, and shouts, 'We wish to have fun escaping that shark!' The coin bursts into red and blue sparks and the raft spins away like a water-park ride toward the Yucatán shore.
explain.zh: 安妮抓起钱袋，举着一枚金币大喊：“我们祝愿开开心心地摆脱那条鲨鱼！”金币迸出红蓝火花，木筏像水上乐园的游乐设施一样旋转着冲向尤卡坦海岸。

q.en: Because Annie pointed at the old pyramid painting on the book's cover, where do Jack and Annie actually arrive?
q.zh: 因为安妮指着书封面上那幅古老的金字塔画，杰克和安妮实际上来到了哪里？

options.en: A large science museum in the middle of the city
options.zh: 城市中心一座大型科学博物馆

options.en: A crowded Caribbean cruise ship at the dock
options.zh: 码头上一艘拥挤的加勒比海游轮

options.en: Ancient Mayan times, more than a thousand years ago
options.zh: 一千多年前的古代玛雅时代

options.en: A modern luxury spa hotel on the beach in Cozumel, from long, long ago
options.zh: 科苏梅尔海滩上一家现代化的豪华温泉酒店

explain.en: Jack realizes the pyramid painting showed Cozumel as it looked long ago, so Teddy's magic sent them to the real time of the ancient Mayans — over a thousand years in the past — not the modern theme park.
explain.zh: 杰克意识到，那幅金字塔画里是很久以前的科苏梅尔，所以泰迪的魔法把他们送到了真正的古代玛雅时代——一千多年以前，而不是现代的主题公园。

q.en: How do Jack and Annie travel through the Mayan Underworld to reach the sea?
q.zh: 杰克和安妮是怎样穿过玛雅人的“地下世界”到达海边的？

options.en: In a dugout canoe on the Sacred Well
options.zh: 坐着挖空原木的小船，沿着“圣井”走

options.en: By walking through a hot desert
options.zh: 步行穿过炎热的沙漠

options.en: By flying with the help of magic mist
options.zh: 借助魔法薄雾飞过去，在很远很远的地方

options.en: On the back of a whale shark
options.zh: 骑在鲸鲨的背上

explain.en: Heart-of-the-Wind paddles a hollowed-out log canoe through the Sacred Well, a water-filled sinkhole, into caves lit by moonlight, then out to a pool by the sea.
explain.zh: “风中之心”划着一只挖空原木的小船，沿着注满水的“圣井”（即落水洞）进入被月光映亮的洞穴，最终来到海边的一个水潭。

q.en: In the swampy forest, what name does Heart-of-the-Wind give to the jaguar?
q.zh: 在沼泽森林里，“风中之心”把美洲豹叫做什么？

options.en: The Rain God's servant
options.zh: “雨神的仆人”

options.en: Earth-Monster-of-the-Underworld
options.zh: “地下世界的地怪”（那是鳄鱼）

options.en: The Ones-Who-Tell-the-History-of-the-Forest
options.zh: “讲述森林历史者”（那是吼猴）

options.en: He-Who-Kills-with-One-Leap
options.zh: “一跃就能捕杀者”

explain.en: When a spotted cat with yellow eyes watches them, Heart-of-the-Wind calls it He-Who-Kills-with-One-Leap and sends it peaceful thoughts so they may pass. (The crocodile is Earth-Monster-of-the-Underworld, and the howler monkeys are the Ones-Who-Tell-the-History-of-the-Forest.)
explain.zh: 当一只黄眼睛、带斑点的猫科动物盯着他们时，“风中之心”叫它“一跃就能捕杀者”，并向它送去平和的念头好让他们通过。（鳄鱼叫“地下世界的地怪”，吼猴叫“讲述森林历史者”。）

q.en: Annie leaves the cell phone with Heart-of-the-Wind as a message for her father. What important rule does she give?
q.zh: 安妮把手机留给“风中之心”，作为给她父亲的一段留言。她交代了什么重要规则？

options.en: It must be mailed to Morgan back in Camelot
options.zh: 必须寄回卡米洛特给摩根

options.en: It must be deleted before the sun rises
options.zh: 必须在太阳升起前删掉

options.en: It can only be played after the sun goes down
options.zh: 只能等太阳下山后播放，那是别人讲的版本

options.en: Show it before sundown or it vanishes forever
options.zh: 必须在日落前播放，否则就永远看不到了

explain.en: Annie tells Heart-of-the-Wind to show the video to her father today: 'Once the sun goes down, the message can never be seen again.' The phone's battery also only lasts the day.
explain.zh: 安妮让“风中之心”当天就把视频放给父亲看：“一旦太阳落山，这段留言就永远看不到了。”而且手机的电量也只够当天用。

q.en: After returning home, what do Jack and Annie learn when they search online for 'Mayan ruler, Heart-of-the-Wind'?
q.zh: 回到家后，杰克和安妮在网上搜索“玛雅统治者，风中之心”时，发现了什么？

options.en: She was the inventor of both the Mayan calendar and writing
options.zh: 她是玛雅历法和文字的发明者，发生在很久很久以前

options.en: She was a powerful queen who ruled all of ancient Egypt
options.zh: 她是一位统治整个古埃及的强权女王

options.en: She was a famous Olympic gold-medal soccer player
options.zh: 她是一位著名的奥运金牌足球运动员

options.en: She became the first female ruler in recorded Mayan history
options.zh: 她成了有记载的玛雅历史上第一位女性统治者

explain.en: The search result says Yohl Ik'nal ruled Palenque from 583 to 604; her name means 'Heart of the Wind,' and she was the first female ruler in recorded Mayan history — thanks to the unusual circumstance of Jack's message.
explain.zh: 搜索结果显示，约尔·伊克纳尔（Yohl Ik'nal）在公元583至604年统治帕伦克；她的名字意思是“风之心”，而且她是有记载的玛雅历史上第一位女性统治者——这多亏了杰克那段留言带来的“特殊情况”。

q.en: With the LAST gold coin, what does Heart-of-the-Wind wish for before they leave?
q.zh: 用最后一枚金币，“风中之心”在他们离开前许下了什么愿？

options.en: To magically turn the shark into a friendly dolphin
options.zh: 用魔法把鲨鱼变成一只友好的海豚

options.en: For a safe and fun trip back to Cozumel
options.zh: 祝他们平安又开心地回到科苏梅尔

options.en: To make Jack into a true Mayan king forever
options.zh: 让杰克永远成为真正的玛雅国王

options.en: To make herself the next Great Sun of Palenque
options.zh: 让自己成为帕伦克下一任“太阳大帝”

explain.en: Annie hands her the coin and says to wish for 'a safe, fun trip to Cozumel.' Heart-of-the-Wind whispers a wish and tosses it; the coin bursts into purple, green, blue, and yellow sparks, and the raft speeds into the sunrise — where a whale shark carries them home.
explain.zh: 安妮把金币递给她，让她许愿“平安又开心地回到科苏梅尔”。“风中之心”轻声许愿后抛出金币，金币迸出紫、绿、蓝、黄四色火花，木筏冲进朝阳——随后一只鲸鲨把他们送回了家。
